the method of the request, set by the server and never by the client

Read by `backoffice-maintenance`, which runs in front of this route.

parameters.name: x-client-ip

the ip of the connection, set by the server and never by the client

Read by `backoffice-client-ip`, which runs in front of this route.

parameters.name: x-forwarded-for
parameters.description:
the client chain a reverse proxy appended to, read only with --allow-x-forwarded-for

Read by `backoffice-client-ip`, which runs in front of this route.

200.description: It worked. The answer comes as `application/json`.

get.summary: Serves the public website: the frontend/ folder of the website source

parameters.name: Rest
parameters.description:
the file under the frontend/ folder of the website source, else that path plus .html; none is its index.html

The rest of the address — one part or more, like `a/b.png`.

parameters.name: x-request-method
parameters.description: the method of the request, set by the server and never by the client: a HEAD is no page view

parameters.name: user-agent
parameters.description: the device, browser and operating system a page view is recorded with

parameters.name: referer
parameters.description: the site a page view came from, recorded when it is another one

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: the host the request was sent to: a Referer naming it is a link inside the site

parameters.name: x-client-ip
parameters.description:
the ip of the connection, set by the server and never by the client

Read by `backoffice-client-ip`, which runs in front of this route.

parameters.name: x-forwarded-for
parameters.description:
the client chain a reverse proxy appended to, read only with --allow-x-forwarded-for

Read by `backoffice-client-ip`, which runs in front of this route.

200.description: It worked. The answer comes as `text/html; charset=utf-8`.

field.description: the value that was wrong, when it is one
